description:
Port pi-ai's event union (types.ts:248-260) to Elixir structs:
- `%OctoPi.AI.Event.Start{partial}`
- `%OctoPi.AI.Event.TextDelta{content_index, delta, partial}`
- `%OctoPi.AI.Event.ThinkingDelta{...}`
- `%OctoPi.AI.Event.ToolCallDelta{...}`, `ToolCallEnd{tool_call, ...}`
- `%OctoPi.AI.Event.Done{reason, message}`
- `%OctoPi.AI.Event.Error{reason, error}`

Also: `OctoPi.AI.Provider` behaviour with `stream/3` and `stream_simple/3`. `%OctoPi.AI.Context{system_prompt, messages, tools}`, `%OctoPi.AI.StreamOptions{...}`.

No implementation yet — just the contract.
title: Define OctoPi.AI.Provider behaviour + canonical event types
